info.title: Pure Public API
info.description: Public API for accessing Pure marketplace data including products, spot prices, and more.

get.description: Get information about the API and available endpoints

Retrieve all product analytics

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: The ID of the product to get analytics for

parameters.name: variantId
parameters.description: The ID of the variant to get analytics for

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: The range of days to get analytics for

get.description:
Retrieve all product activity

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: The ID of the product to get activity for

parameters.name: variantId
parameters.description: The ID of the variant to get activity for

get.description:
Retrieve the order book for a product

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

get.summary: Get live orderbook for a product
get.description:
Retrieve the live orderbook for a product across all variants. Returns active listings and offers from the `orderbook_listing_live` and `orderbook_offer_live` views (already filtered to active, non-expired, trading-enabled organizations).

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve a single product with all variants (including best offer/listing and order book per variant) and recent activity.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all product catalog metadata in a single request — categories, subcategories, manufacturers, materials, attributes, and certificate providers.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Search and browse products with full-text search, filtering, and facets. Returns enriched product data with variants hydrated from the database.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query. Omit or pass '*' to browse all products.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10, max 250)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of products to skip for pagination

parameters.name: filter_by
parameters.description: Typesense filter expression (e.g. 'material:=Gold && has_listing:=true')

get.description:
Search for products. When no query is provided, returns all products with pagination.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query string

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: Pagination parameters (limit and offset)

parameters.name: filter_by
parameters.description: Typesense filter expression (e.g. 'material:=Gold && has_listing:=true')

get.description:
Search for products. When no query is provided, returns all products with pagination.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query. Omit or pass '*' to browse all products.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10, max 250)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of products to skip for pagination

parameters.name: filter_by
parameters.description: Typesense filter expression (e.g. 'material:=Gold && has_listing:=true')

get.description:
Retrieve all product options with images, categories, and variants

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all product certificate providers

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all product attributes

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all product materials

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve products by their IDs with variants, offers, and listings

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma separated list of product IDs to retrieve

get.description:
Retrieve products filtered by material and attributes, with variants, offers, and listings. Returns paginated results.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Filter by material (Gold, Silver, Platinum, Palladium, Bitcoin)

parameters.name: attributeIds
parameters.description: Comma separated attribute IDs (AND semantics)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of products to skip for pagination

get.description:
Retrieve all product categories

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all product subcategories

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all product manufacturers

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve current spot prices for all precious metals. This endpoint returns the current bid/ask prices, market status, and price changes for all supported materials.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve the recommended shipping date for the product. This endpoint returns the two day and overnight shipping dates.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve all products for the sitemap. This endpoint returns the sku and updatedAt for all products.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

Retrieve aggregate marketplace statistics including total ask/bid amounts, listing/offer counts, and product counts. Stats are recalculated every minute.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

totalAskAmount.description: Total value of all active listings in cents

totalBidAmount.description: Total value of all active offers in cents

totalProductCount.description: Total number of products with active orderbook entries

updatedAt.description: When the stats were last calculated

get.description:
Get the organization details associated with the authenticated API key. Sensitive fields such as access tokens and internal IDs are excluded.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

patch.description:
Update one or more settings for the authenticated organization. Only the provided fields will be modified. Supports vacation mode, payout method, and electronic check details.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

vacationMode.description: Enable or disable vacation mode. When active, listings and offers are hidden from the marketplace.

payoutMethod.description: Default payout method for the organization

electronicCheckName.description: Payee name for electronic check payouts

electronicCheckEmail.description: Payee email for electronic check payouts

get.description:
List the purchase orders for the authenticated organization. Results are scoped to the API key's organization — you cannot access another organization's orders.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by order status

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of orders to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of orders to skip (for pagination)

get.description:
List the sale orders for the authenticated organization. Results are scoped to the API key's organization — you cannot access another organization's orders.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by order status

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of orders to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of orders to skip (for pagination)

post.description:
Create a new orderbook listing for the authenticated organization.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

price.description: Price in cents. Required for fixed_pricing type

get.description:
Retrieve orderbook listings for the authenticated organization with optional filtering by active status and product ID. Results include related product and variant details.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active status

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Filter by product ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of listings to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of listings to skip (for pagination)

get.description:
Retrieve live orderbook listings for the authenticated organization. Only returns active, non-expired listings with valid pricing from trading-enabled organizations (via `orderbook_listing_live` view).

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Filter by product ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of listings to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of listings to skip (for pagination)

get.summary: Get listing statistics for your organization
get.description:
Retrieve aggregate statistics about the authenticated organization's orderbook listings, including counts, quantities, and total value.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

totalValue.description: Sum of price * quantity in cents

delete.description:
Deactivate an orderbook listing owned by the authenticated organization. This sets the listing's active status to false rather than permanently deleting it.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

patch.description:
Update fields on an orderbook listing owned by the authenticated organization. Only the provided fields will be updated.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

post.description:
Create a new orderbook offer (bid) for the authenticated organization.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

price.description: Price in cents. Required for fixed_pricing type

get.description:
Retrieve orderbook offers (bids) for the authenticated organization with optional filtering by active status and product ID. Results include related product and variant details.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active status

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Filter by product ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of offers to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of offers to skip (for pagination)

get.description:
Retrieve live orderbook offers for the authenticated organization. Only returns active, non-expired offers with valid pricing from trading-enabled organizations (via `orderbook_offer_live` view).

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Filter by product ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of offers to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of offers to skip (for pagination)

get.summary: Get offer statistics for your organization
get.description:
Retrieve aggregate statistics about the authenticated organization's orderbook offers (bids), including counts, quantities, and total value.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

totalValue.description: Sum of price * quantity in cents

delete.description:
Deactivate an orderbook offer owned by the authenticated organization. This sets the offer's active status to false rather than permanently deleting it.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

patch.description:
Update fields on an orderbook offer owned by the authenticated organization. Only the provided fields will be updated.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

get.description:
Retrieve inventory items for the authenticated organization with optional filtering by product ID. Results include related product and variant details.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Filter by product ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 20, max 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip (for pagination)

purchasePricePer.description: Purchase price per unit in cents

purchaseSpotPrice.description: Spot price at time of purchase in cents

get.summary: Get inventory statistics for your organization
get.description:
Retrieve aggregate statistics about the authenticated organization's inventory, including total items, quantities, cost basis, and unique product count.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.

totalCostBasis.description: Sum of purchase_price_per * quantity across all inventory in cents

get.description:
Returns the health status of the Marketplace API.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests burst, 60 requests/minute sustained.
